report:
Cranial MRI examination:
Sequences used in the examination:
Axial plane; FLAIR and T2 W FSE,
Sagittal plane; T2 W FSE,
Coronal plane; T1 W SE.

The fourth ventricle is of normal size and configuration. Basal cisterns are open. Cerebellar hemispheres, vermis, and brainstem are of normal signal intensity and configuration.

Both internal acoustic canals are of normal width. Sella is of normal form. Both cavernous sinuses are symmetric and of normal signal intensity.

Convexity sulci are compatible with patient age. Cerebral white and gray matter signal separation is normal, and pathological signal change was not detected.

Corpus callosum is of normal signal intensity and configuration.
Pericallosal pathology was not detected. Ventricular system is of normal width, and the third ventricle is midline. No deviation was observed in midline structures.

Extra- and intraaxial collections and mass formation were not detected.
No findings suggestive of thrombus were detected in dural sinuses. A 13 mm diameter retention cyst appearance and millimetric thickness mucosal thickening are noted in the right maxillary sinus. Aeration of other paranasal sinuses and mastoid cells is normal.

Impression:
- No neural parenchymal pathology was observed
- Appearance of a retention cyst in the right maxillary sinus and millimetric mucosal thickening
